trap.label: fala argumentativa
trap.wrong: In my opinion, the reason is because he is lazy. For exemple, he sleeps late.
trap.right: In my opinion, one reason is that he is lazy. For example, he sleeps late.
trap.why: Em português “a razão é porque” e “exemplo” (exemplo) enganam: o brasileiro escreve exemple e usa because após reason. Em inglês: reason is that…; example.

fix.wrong: The reason is because it is cheap.
fix.right: The reason is that it is cheap.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I think remote work is great.” (In my opinion)
rewrite.answer: In my opinion, remote work is great.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Because it saves time” → “One reason ... it saves time.”
rewrite.answer: One reason is that it saves time.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Finally, I believe it is good.” (In conclusion)
rewrite.answer: In conclusion, I believe it is good.
